00008 {
00009         int fct = 1;
00010         int i;
00011         if( num_in <= 0 )

00014                 fct *= i;
00015         return fct;
00016 }

00087 int combinadic_vector( int idx_in, int lim_in, int dim_in, int *vec_out )
00088 {
00089         int i,j,idx,tmp;
00090 
00091         if( idx_in < 0 )
00092                 return -1;
00093 
00094         idx = idx_in;
00095         for(i=dim_in-1;i>=0;i--)
00096         {
00097                 for(j=i+1;j<=lim_in;j++)
00098                 {
00099                         tmp = binomial( j, i + 1 );
00100                         if( tmp > idx )
00101                                 break;
00102                 }
00103                 idx -= binomial( j - 1, i + 1 );
00104                 vec_out[i] = j - 1;
00105         }
00106         return 0;
00107 }

00251 int factoradic_radix_index( int dim_in, int idx_in, int *rad_out )
00252 {
00253         int i,fct,div,rem;
00254 
00255         rem = idx_in;
00256         for(i=dim_in-1;i>=0;i--)
00257         {
00258                 fct = factorial( i );
00259                 div = rem / fct;
00260                 rem = rem % fct;
00261                 rad_out[dim_in-1-i] = div;
00262         }
00263 }

00418 int binary_search( long int *i_in, long int *list_in, long int *llen_in, long int *idx_out, long int *its_out )
00419 {
00420         long int left,right;
00421         left = 0;
00422         right = *llen_in - 1;
00423         return binary_search_range( i_in, &left, &right, list_in, llen_in, idx_out, its_out );
00424 }
00425 
00426 int binary_search_range( long int *i_in, long int *left_in, long int *right_in, long int *list_in, long int *llen_in, long int *idx_out, long int *its_out )
00427 {
00428         long int left,right;
00429         *its_out = 0;
00430         if( *llen_in > 0 )
00431         {
00432                 left = *left_in;
00433                 right = *right_in;
00434                 while(left<=right)
00435                 {
00436                         *idx_out = ( left + right ) / 2;
00437                         if( list_in[*idx_out] == *i_in )
00438                                 return 0;
00439                         else
00440                         {
00441                                 if( list_in[*idx_out] < *i_in )
00442                                         left = *idx_out + 1;
00443                                 else
00444                                         right = *idx_out - 1;
00445                         }
00446                         *its_out = *its_out + 1;
00447                 }
00448                 return -1;
00449         }
00450         else
00451         {
00452                 *idx_out = 0;
00453                 return -1;
00454         }
00455 }

00465 int binary_closest_range( long int *i_in, long int *left_in, long int *right_in, long int *list_in, long int *llen_in, long int *idx_out, long int *its_out )
00466 {
00467         long int idx;
00468         if( binary_search_range( i_in, left_in, right_in, list_in, llen_in, &idx, its_out ) == -1 )
00469         {
00470                 if( *llen_in > 0 && idx > -1 )
00471                         *idx_out = list_in[idx] > *i_in ? idx - 1 : idx;
00472                 else
00473                         *idx_out = -1;
00474                 return -1;
00475         }
00476         else
00477         {
00478                 *idx_out = idx;
00479                 return 0;
00480         }
00481 }

00623 int list_init( list_t *list_in, int step_in )
00624 {
00625         void *tmp;
00626 
00627         list_in->start = NULL;
00628         list_in->pointer = NULL;
00629         list_in->step = step_in;
00630         list_in->size = 0;
00631         list_in->alloc = LIST_SIZE_INC;
00632         tmp = realloc( list_in->pointer, LIST_SIZE_INC * step_in );
00633         if( tmp == NULL )
00634                 return -1;
00635         list_in->pointer = tmp;
00636         list_in->start = list_in->pointer;
00637         return 0;
00638 }

00640 int list_free( list_t *list_in )
00641 {
00642         if( list_in->start != NULL && list_in->size > 0 )
00643                 free( list_in->pointer );
00644         else
00645                 return -1;
00646         list_in->pointer = NULL;
00647         list_in->start = NULL;
00648         return 0;

00651 int list_reset( list_t *list_in )
00652 {
00653         if( list_in->size <= 0 )
00654                 return -1;
00655         memmove( list_in->pointer, list_in->start, list_in->size * list_in->step );
00656         list_in->start = list_in->pointer;
00657         return 0;
00658 }

00660 int list_shift( list_t *list_in, int shift_in )
00661 {
00662         if( list_in->size <= 0
00663          || ( ( (byte_t*) list_in->start + shift_in * list_in->step ) < list_in->pointer )
00664          || ( ( (byte_t*) list_in->start + ( list_in->size + shift_in ) * list_in->step ) > ( (byte_t*) list_in->pointer + list_in->alloc * list_in->step ) ) )
00665                 return -1;
00666         if( shift_in == 0 )
00667                 return 0;
00668         list_in->start = memmove( (byte_t*) list_in->start + shift_in * list_in->step, list_in->start, list_in->size * list_in->step );
00669         return 0;
00670 }
00671 
00672 int list_grow( list_t *list_in, int minc_in )
00673 {
00674         void *tmp;
00675         list_reset( list_in );
00676         tmp = realloc( list_in->pointer, ( list_in->alloc + minc_in ) * list_in->step );
00677         if( tmp == NULL )
00678                 return -1;
00679         list_in->pointer = tmp;
00680         list_in->start = list_in->pointer;
00681         list_in->alloc += minc_in;
00682         return list_in->alloc;
00683 }

00685 int list_shrink( list_t *list_in, int mdec_in )
00686 {
00687         void *tmp;
00688         list_reset( list_in ); /* Force list_in->start to coincide with list_in->pointer */
00689         tmp = realloc( list_in->pointer, ( list_in->alloc - mdec_in ) * list_in->step );
00690         if( tmp == NULL )
00691                 return -1;
00692         list_in->pointer = tmp;
00693         list_in->start = list_in->pointer;
00694         list_in->alloc -= mdec_in;
00695         return list_in->alloc;

00698 int list_prepend( list_t *list_in, void *val_in )
00699 {
00700         if( list_in->size + 1 > list_in->alloc )
00701         {
00702                 if( list_grow( list_in, LIST_SIZE_INC ) == -1 )
00703                         return -1;
00704                 if( list_shift( list_in, 1 ) == -1 )
00705                         return -1;
00706         }
00707         else
00708         {
00709                 if( list_in->start <= list_in->pointer ) /* Meaning there is no memory allocated to the left, so make some */
00710                         if( list_shift( list_in, 1 ) == -1 )
00711                                 return -1;
00712         }
00713         list_in->start = (byte_t*) list_in->start - list_in->step;
00714         bcopy( val_in, list_in->start, list_in->step );
00715         ++list_in->size;
00716         return list_in->size;
00717 }

00719 int list_append( list_t *list_in, void *val_in )
00720 {
00721         /* If there isn't enough memory allocated */
00722         if( list_in->size + 1 > list_in->alloc )
00723         {
00724                 if( list_grow( list_in, LIST_SIZE_INC ) == -1 )
00725                         return -1;
00726         }
00727         else /* If there is enough, then either there is some at the beginning or some at the end */
00728         {
00729                 if( (byte_t*)list_in->start > (byte_t*)list_in->pointer )
00730                         if( list_shift( list_in, -1 ) == -1 )
00731                                 return -1;
00732         }
00733 
00734         bcopy( val_in, (byte_t*) list_in->start + list_in->size * list_in->step, list_in->step );
00735         ++list_in->size;
00736         return list_in->size;
00737 }

00739 int list_popf( list_t *list_in, void *ptr_out )
00740 {
00741         if( list_in->size <= 0 )
00742                 return -1;
00743         bcopy( list_in->start, ptr_out, list_in->step );
00744         if( list_in->size > 1 )
00745                 list_in->start = (byte_t*) list_in->start + list_in->step;
00746         --list_in->size;
00747         if( list_in->alloc - list_in->size >= LIST_SIZE_INC )
00748                 if( list_shrink( list_in, LIST_SIZE_INC ) == -1 )
00749                         return -1;
00750         return 0;
00751 }

00753 int list_popb( list_t *list_in, void *ptr_out )
00754 {
00755         if( list_in->size <= 0 )
00756                 return -1;
00757         else
00758                 bcopy( (byte_t*) list_in->start + ( list_in->size - 1 ) * list_in->step, ptr_out, list_in->step );
00759         --list_in->size;
00760         if( list_in->alloc - list_in->size >= LIST_SIZE_INC )
00761                 if( list_shrink( list_in, LIST_SIZE_INC ) == -1 )
00762                         return -1;
00763         return 0;
